This Petition, Coming On For Admission, This Day,
Order Was Made Therein As Under:
 Oral Order
(Per: The Hon'Ble Mr. Justice V.Srishananda)
Learned counsel for the petitioners has filed a memo for withdrawal.

The memo reads as under:
"That in the above case, the petitioners have challenged the FIR and complaint filed by the respondent No.1 with instigation of respondent No.2 bearing Kamalapur PS Crime No.74/2025 for the offences punishable Under Sec.498A, 504, 506 of IPC Prl Civil Judge (Sr.Dn) and JMFC Court Hosapete after filing the above petition the IO has submitted that charge sheet against the petitioners in the above crime, therefore the petitioners may kindly be permitted to withdraw the petition and liberty may kindly reserve for challenging the charge sheet filed in Kamalapur PS Crime No.74/2025 and liberty to file NC: 2026:KHC-D:1633 HC-KAR the fresh petition, in the interest of justice and equity."
2. Placing the memo on record, petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as prayed for.
